title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 29: the letter to the captives in Babylon, the seventy years, and the words against the prophets who lied.

questions.text: What did Jeremiah send from Jerusalem to the elders, priests, prophets and people carried away to Babylon?
questions.explanation: The chapter begins with the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, the prophets and all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away.

answers.text: A yoke of wood
A letter
A basket of figs
The vessels of Yahweh's house

questions.text: By whose hand was it sent to Babylon?
questions.explanation: It was sent by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar.

answers.text: By Ahab the son of Kolaiah and his servants
By Shemaiah the Nehelamite and the priests
By Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest
By Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah

questions.text: What were the captives told to do in the land where they had been carried?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit," and to take wives and have sons and daughters, and multiply there.

answers.text: Build houses and dwell in them, plant gardens and eat their fruit
Keep their tents ready to leave within two years
Refuse to work for the people of the city
Return at once to Jerusalem

questions.text: What were they told to seek and to pray to Yahweh for?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to seek the peace of the city where He had caused them to be carried away captive and to pray to Yahweh for it, for in its peace they would have peace.

answers.text: The fall of all their enemies around
A sign from their own prophets and diviners
The peace of the city where they were carried captive
Rain on the whole land of Judah

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh warn the captives not to let deceive them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Don't let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don't listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed," for they prophesied falsely in his name.

answers.text: The princes of Judah
Their own prophets and diviners
The craftsmen and the smiths
The king of Babylon's servants

questions.text: After what time did Yahweh say He would visit them and cause them to return to this place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place."

answers.text: After two full years in Babylon
After twenty-three years of captivity
After three generations in that land
After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon

questions.text: What kind of thoughts did Yahweh say He thinks toward them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future."

answers.text: Thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give them hope and a future
Thoughts of wrath, to make a full end of them
Thoughts that He would not tell to anyone at all
Thoughts of justice only, and not of mercy

questions.text: When did Yahweh say they would seek Him and find Him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart."

answers.text: When their prophets spoke for them
When the seventy years had begun
When they searched for Him with all their heart
When they returned to the temple

questions.text: Which two men who prophesied a lie in Yahweh's name would be delivered into Nebuchadnezzar's hand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesied a lie in his name, and said He would deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

answers.text: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
Elasah and Gemariah
Jehoiada the priest and Zephaniah the priest
Jeconiah the king and the queen mother

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring, that he would not have a man to dwell among this people, and that he would not see the good Yahweh would do for his people.

answers.text: That they would be brought back first of all the captives
That they would be made priests in Yahweh's house
That they would be given a heart to know Yahweh
That He would punish them, and Shemaiah would not see the good Yahweh would do
